celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ i.e. the Quran ﴿لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ﴾ when they see the reward of those who believed in it and the punishment of those who denied it.

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ i.e. the Quran ﴿لَحَقُّ الْيَقِينِ﴾ i.e. the true certainty.

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿فَسَبِّحْ﴾ declare transcendent ﴿بِاسْمِ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ﴾ glory be to Him.

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الْحَاقَّةُ﴾: the Resurrection, in which there comes true what was denied of the raising, the reckoning and the recompense; or (it means) the one that makes that manifest.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿مَا الْحَاقَّةُ﴾: a magnifying of its import; and it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), the khabar of الْحَاقَّةُ.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ﴾ informed you ﴿مَا الْحَاقَّةُ﴾: a further magnifying of its import. So the first مَا is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and what follows it is its khabar (predicate), and the second مَا with its khabar is in the position of the second object of أَدْرَى.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌ بِالْقَارِعَةِ﴾ the Resurrection, because it strikes (taqraʿu) the hearts with its terrors.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ﴾ by the Shout that exceeded the limit in severity.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ﴾ loud-sounding, ﴿عَاتِيَةٍ﴾ strong, severe upon ʿĀd despite their strength and severity,

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿سَخَّرَهَا﴾ He sent it forcibly ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ﴾ — the first of them from the morning of Wednesday, with eight (nights) remaining of Shawwāl, and it was at the tail end of winter — ﴿حُسُومًا﴾ successive: likened to the successive action of the cauteriser (al-ḥāsim) in repeating the cautery on the disease time after time until it is cut off (yanḥasim). ﴿فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَى﴾ thrown down, perished, ﴿كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ﴾ stumps ﴿نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ﴾ fallen, hollow.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿فَهَلْ تَرَى لَهُمْ مِنْ بَاقِيَةٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of an implied نَفْس (soul), or the tāʾ is for intensiveness (mubālagha), i.e. a remnant? No.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَنْ قِبَلَهُ﴾ his followers — and in a reading [قَبْلَهُ], with fatḥa on the qāf and sukūn on the bāʾ, i.e. those disbelieving nations who preceded him — ﴿وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ﴾, i.e. their people, and they are the towns of the people of Lot, ﴿بِالْخَاطِئَةِ﴾ with deeds possessing error,

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿فَعَصَوْا رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ﴾, i.e. Lot and others, ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَابِيَةً﴾ exceeding others in severity.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْمَاءُ﴾ rose above everything, of the mountains and other things, at the time of the Flood, ﴿حَمَلْنَاكُمْ﴾, meaning your forefathers, since you were in their loins, ﴿فِي الْجَارِيَةِ﴾ the ship which Noah made, in which he and those with him were saved, while the rest were drowned,

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿لِنَجْعَلَهَا﴾, i.e. this deed — which is saving the believers and destroying the disbelievers — ﴿لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً﴾ an admonition, ﴿وَتَعِيَهَا﴾ and so that there may retain it ﴿أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ﴾ retaining what it hears.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ﴾ for judging between the creatures — and it is the second (blast) —

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَحُمِلَتِ﴾ are lifted ﴿الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا﴾ are crushed ﴿دَكَّةً وَاحِدَةً﴾

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ﴾: the Resurrection has come to pass,

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿وَالْمَلَكُ﴾, meaning the angels, ﴿عَلَى أَرْجَائِهَا﴾ the sides of the sky; ﴿وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ﴾, i.e. the angels mentioned, ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةٌ﴾ of the angels, or of their ranks.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ﴾ for the reckoning; ﴿لَا تَخْفَى﴾, with tāʾ and with yāʾ, ﴿مِنْكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ﴾ of secrets.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ﴾, addressing his group, because of his joy at it: ﴿هَاؤُمُ﴾ take, ﴿اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ﴾ — هَاؤُمُ and اقْرَؤُوا contend for it (tanāzuʿ).

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿إِنِّي ظَنَنْتُ﴾ I was certain ﴿أَنِّي مُلَاقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ﴾

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿قُطُوفُهَا﴾ its fruits ﴿دَانِيَةٌ﴾ near, reached by the one standing, sitting and reclining; and it will be said to them:

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. enjoying (it) wholesomely, ﴿بِمَا أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ﴾ the bygone days in this world.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَا﴾ — for alerting (tanbīh) — ﴿لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَابِيَهْ﴾

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿يَا لَيْتَهَا﴾, i.e. the death in this world, ﴿كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ﴾ the one cutting off my life, so that I would not be resurrected.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿مَا أَغْنَى عَنِّي مَالِيَهْ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطَانِيَهْ﴾ my strength and my argument. The hāʾ of كِتَابِيَهْ, حِسَابِيَهْ, مَالِيَهْ and سُلْطَانِيَهْ is the hāʾ of pause (hāʾ al-sakt); it is retained in pausing and in continuing, following the Imam codex (muṣḥaf al-imām) and transmission; and some drop it in continuing.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿خُذُوهُ﴾: an address to the keepers of Hell; ﴿فَغُلُّوهُ﴾ gather his hands to his neck in the iron collar,

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ﴾ the burning Fire ﴿صَلُّوهُ﴾ make him enter,

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا﴾ by the cubit of the angel ﴿فَاسْلُكُوهُ﴾, i.e. insert him into it after making him enter the Fire; and the fāʾ does not prevent the verb from being attached to the preceding adverbial (ẓarf).

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَهُنَا حَمِيمٌ﴾ a relative from whom he can benefit,

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ﴾ the pus of the people of the Fire, or a tree in it,

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿فَلَا﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ﴾ of created things

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ﴾ of them, i.e. by every created thing,

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾, i.e. the Quran, ﴿لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ﴾, i.e. he said it as a message from Allah the Exalted.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلًا مَا تُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here; it comments on this verse together with the next.]

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ — with tāʾ and with yāʾ in both verbs, and مَا is added (mazīda) for emphasis. The meaning is that they believed in and heeded a few things of what the Prophet ﷺ brought — of goodness, keeping ties of kinship and chastity — but it availed them nothing. Rather, it is

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here beyond the words "rather, it is" at the end of the previous verse.]

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ﴾, i.e. the Prophet, ﴿عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ﴾ by saying from Us what We did not say,

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿لَأَخَذْنَا﴾ We would have inflicted ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ punishment ﴿بِالْيَمِينِ﴾ with strength and power,

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ﴾ the aorta of the heart, which is a vein connected to it; when it is cut, its owner dies.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿فَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ﴾: it is the ism of مَا, and مِنْ is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasising the negation, and مِنْكُمْ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from أَحَدٍ; ﴿عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ﴾ preventing: the khabar (predicate) of مَا, put in the plural because أَحَدٌ in the context of negation has the sense of a plural; and the pronoun of عَنْهُ refers to the Prophet ﷺ; i.e. there would be none to hold Us back from him in terms of punishment.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنْكُمْ﴾, O people, ﴿مُكَذِّبِينَ﴾ the Quran, and some who affirm it.
